description: Renders the element only when the expression is truthy. Content is destroyed and recreated on every toggle.
Extra branches of a `v-if` chain. They must directly follow a `v-if` or `v-else-if` sibling.
Always renders the element and toggles `display: none`. Cheap to toggle, no `v-else`, not usable on `<template>`.
An invisible wrapper that lets one `v-if` control several elements without adding a DOM node.
In Vue 3 `v-if` is evaluated before `v-for` on the same element (the reverse of Vue 2). Never combine them on one element.
